hardwareProfiles: To be recorded after benchmark devices selected. Never claim passed without real execution.

cases.expected: With network disabled launch fresh app; no sign-in prompt and New Local Adventure enabled.
On first launch no valid save: Continue is disabled or hidden; New Local Adventure works.
Enter playable name and select all proposed categories using keyboard alone; input focus visible.
Complete character creation fully in Android airplane mode; no server call needed.
Select each WS-004/008/050 and preview original source art; confirm twice, grants exactly one local starter.
Cancel confirmation; no starter granted and selection reopens without lost choices.
Interrupt save during starter confirmation; recovery never duplicates or loses starter.
On Android 16:9 and 20:9, both look drag and virtual joystick work without button overlap; no notch occlusion.
On Windows, no touchscreen joystick drawn; WASD, mouse-look, E and Esc have clear UI equivalents.
No focused target: context prompt hidden. One target in reach: correct label. Out-of-reach target: no false interaction.
Before Q001 compass acquisition show locked state with Fen hint; after acquisition show real scan UI.
Dialog opens, player stops moving, mouse is released, Esc/Android back closes; dialogue remains re-readable.
Forest puzzle supports A→B→C on keyboard and touch; wrong order resets safely; no time limit.
Echo Hollow ON/OFF/ON toggle puzzle distinctly presents switch states, separate from forest sequence.
Moves 1..4 reflect active species typed move slots and real energy costs; unaffordable disabled with reason.
Submitting move once locks buttons; rapidly pressing/tapping again does not advance second action.
Skip animation changes animation duration only, not HP/energy/status event list or winner.
Tutorial guardian loss offers retry without item loss; reward shown after success once only.
While offline paused, battles/world simulation does not advance, no forced turn timer.
Save shows 'Saved locally' only after durable write acknowledgement; failed write gives actionable error.
Exit and reload retains creature, zone, quest flags and puzzle progress without connectivity.
Creature invitation only enabled at >= proposed trust threshold; no unlimited repeat rewards.
When party full, incoming creature reaches reserve or recruitment is gated until reserve exists; never deleted.
Undiscovered and unreleased species are not presented as available to collect.
Quest clues and resolved objectives available without going online; journal survives close and reopen.
Compass cannot be discarded; inventory display never modifies authoritative item counts.
150% text scale does not clip primary menu buttons and 48dp primary touch targets remain.
Reduced motion and mute preserve visual equivalent of signal and battle status clues.
Map shows visited area but no undiscovered secret route; keyboard and Android back work.
Corrupted primary save prompts backup restore, never silently resets or overwrites player progress.
Offline Online Expedition explains connection requirement while Local Adventure remains enabled.
Online disconnection returns to retry/leave flow, with no writes to local story save.
No trusted online trade/PvP rewards can be claimed from edited local save.
Trade confirmation gated by server final state and idempotent confirmation; later phase only.
No UI can grant cosmetic entitlements before verified store receipt; later phase only.
Phone thermal/low-memory UX stress: 30-minute navigation, repeated screen changes, no runaway retained atlases, actual profiling required.
Alt+Tab/application background suspends or safely retains input focus; no runaway camera rotation on return.
Wild ecology interaction is accessible without mandatory optional combat; Invite label remains correct for local-only creature ownership.
Dialogue expands 50% length without critical text truncation and speaker remains identifiable.
Low-vision/color-blind cues: signal indicators use text and glyph pattern, not only cyan glow.
